title: ophiopogon stenophyllus
intro: Ophiopogon stenophyllus, commonly known as Dwarf Mondo Grass or Chinese Mondo Grass, is a type of evergreen, rhizomatous perennial grass native to China. It is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and have antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophiopogon stenophyllus include anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Ophiopogon stenophyllus include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
